description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the Pipeline interface, allowing execution of FunctionExpression objects over a sequence of stage expressions. It provides methods for executing, validating, and comparing pipeline instances.

classes.name: ImmutablePipeline
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Pipeline interface capable of executing its contained FunctionExpressions over given pipeline stages.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pipeline by applying each expression in stageExpressions to the input element, resolving each with the provided ExpressionResolver.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that each stage expression is supported by the FunctionExpression; throws an exception if any expression is unsupported.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another ImmutablePipeline instance based on functionExpression and stageExpressions.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on functionExpression and stageExpressions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ImmutablePipeline instance.
